title: Automated Design of Inventory Policy with Large Language Models: An Exploratory Study
abstract: arXiv:2609.08071v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Firms making inventory decisions have access to operational data, optimization tools, and large language models (LLMs). Typically, data characterize the operating environment, optimization selects parameters within a prespecified inventory policy class, and LLMs support coding and decision analysis. We develop an integrated framework that combines these resources to automate inventory policy design. Given demand data, the framework iteratively uses an LLM to generate parameterized policy classes and an external solver to optimize its parameters within each class. Across 30 lost-sales inventory instances, the mean cost reduction relative to optimized base-stock benchmarks increases from 17.5% after one generation to 30.0% after ten generations. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的库存策略自动化设计：一项探索性研究
translated_abstract: 进行库存决策的企业可以获取运营数据、优化工具和大语言模型（LLM）。通常情况下，数据用于刻画运营环境，优化方法用于在预先指定的库存策略类中选择参数，而大语言模型则支持编码和决策分析。我们开发了一个整合框架，将这些资源结合起来以实现库存策略设计的自动化。给定需求数据后，该框架迭代地使用大语言模型生成参数化的策略类，并使用外部求解器在每个策略类内优化其参数。在30个缺货损失库存实例中，相对于优化后的基础库存（base-stock）基准，平均成本降幅从一代迭代后的17.5%提升至十代迭代后的30.0%。参数优化是这一性能的核心：仅使用大语言模型的变体表现明显较差，而优化引导的反馈则提升了策略质量、加速了搜索过程并直接引导了搜索方向。
tldr: 该研究提出了一个整合框架，利用大语言模型迭代生成参数化库存策略类并结合外部求解器优化参数，在30个缺货损失库存实例中实现了相比优化基础库存基准高达30%的成本降低，并证明参数优化对框架性能至关重要。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an integrated framework that iteratively uses LLMs to generate parameterized inventory policy classes and external solvers to optimize their parameters, achieving cost reductions of up to 30% over optimized base-stock benchmarks across 30 lost-sales inventory instances, with parameter optimization being central to its performance.
